connection_condition: tab01.fld063 corresponds to tab04.fld081; every printing's set code resolves to exactly one set.
description: A card printing is part of exactly one set; the set is the whole that its printings compose and a printing cannot exist without its set.

connection_condition: tab03.fld072 corresponds to tab01.fld072 with cascade delete.
description: Format legality records are components of a card printing and are meaningless without it; one printing has up to one legality record per format.

connection_condition: tab06.fld072 corresponds to tab01.fld072 with cascade delete.
description: Rulings are attached to a card printing and are removed with it; a printing may have several rulings.

connection_condition: tab02.fld072 corresponds to tab01.fld072.
description: Localized card records are language-specific components of a printing; each printing may have records in several languages.

connection_condition: tab03.fld076 states the format of the legality row.
description: Each legality record is assessed against one play format.

connection_condition: tab03.fld077 states the status of the legality row.
description: Each legality record carries one of the three legality statuses.

connection_condition: tab02.fld075 states the language of the localized record.
description: Each localized card record is written in exactly one language.

connection_condition: tab02.fld049 holds the name on the same row as tab02.fld075.
description: A localized card record supplies the translated card name for its language.

connection_condition: tab02.fld068 holds the rules text on the same row as tab02.fld075.
description: A localized card record supplies the translated rules text for its language.

connection_condition: tab02.fld017 holds the flavor text on the same row as tab02.fld075.
description: A localized card record supplies the translated flavor text for its language.

connection_condition: tab05.fld063 corresponds to tab04.fld081 and tab05.fld075 selects the language.
description: A set can have translated names in several languages; only 121 of 551 sets do.

connection_condition: tab04.fld049 (and the secondary form fld088) name the same set row.
description: Each set has one English name, with fld088 as a secondary display form for a subset of sets.

connection_condition: tab04.fld079 on the same set row.
description: Some sets belong to a block; block membership is optional.

connection_condition: tab04.fld089 on the same set row; non-null means available on MTGO.
description: A set may be published on Magic: The Gathering Online, recorded as an MTGO product code.

connection_condition: tab01.fld049 and tab02.fld049 both identify the card; tab02 rows are restricted to one language.
description: The English card name and a localized card name express the same business concept in different languages.

connection_condition: tab01.fld068 and tab02.fld068 both hold the card's rules text, in English versus one other language.
description: English rules text and localized rules text are the same concept expressed in different languages.

connection_condition: tab01.fld017 and tab02.fld017 both hold flavor text, in English versus one other language.
description: English and localized flavor text are the same concept in different languages.

connection_condition: tab04.fld049 names the set in English; tab05.fld094 names the same set in another language, joined via set code.
description: English set name and localized set name express the same concept in different languages.
Percentage share is derived from two card counts: 100 × qualifying count / population count.

connection_condition: tab06.fld095 holds the date on the same ruling row as tab06.fld068.
description: Each ruling carries the date on which it was issued.

connection_condition: Legacy original type text such as 'Summon - Angel' embeds a subtype word after the dash; tab01.fld065 holds the modern comma-separated subtype list.
description: Original type wording is related to but distinct from the current subtype list; the historical text may mention a subtype that the modern list represents differently or in combination.

connection_condition: tab01.fld002 and the printing attributes are on the same tab01 row.
description: Each printing credits one artist; the artist is an attribute of the printing rather than a separate keyed entity.

connection_condition: tab01.fld049 is repeated across the printings that share the card name.
description: One card name maps to many printings; counting names and counting printings give different answers.
